title: Giants DL Roy Robertson-Harris suffers torn Achilles during OTAs, expected to miss 2026 season

sources.description: The Giants lost a key piece to their defensive line for the 2026 season on Thursday as DL Roy Robertson-Harris suffered a torn Achilles tendon during OTAs.
